item.title: Minister Andrew Muir welcomes launch of new Rural Data Hub resource
item.description: DAERA Minister, Andrew Muir, has welcomed the launch of the Rural Data Hub, a new resource bringing together rural-specific data into a single, user-friendly dashboard.

item.title: Irish language most spoken in Mid Ulster compared to rest of province
item.description: Councillor Deirdre Varsani (Sinn Féin), who is a strong advocate of the Irish language, has remarked on 2021 Census figures showing that Mid Ulster is topping the Northern Ireland league when it comes to language proficiency, and actual use of Irish in daily life.

item.title: Students spread seasonal cheer with 'John Lewis-style' advert
item.description: Students from the Creative Media course at South West College have showcased their talent through a new advertising project inspired by the work of Experience Enniskillen.

item.title: Dr. John Porteous: 'How do we find what’s wrong with the pipes?'
item.description: To men, health issues are often to be avoided. Problems with your private bits, a definite no-no! A couple of weeks ago, prostate issues were in the headlines with the revelation that the former British Prime Minister, David Cameron, aged 59, has been through treatment for prostate cancer.

item.title: Drunk driver narrowly avoided groups of schoolchildren
item.description: A judge has decided the custody threshold is passed in a drink-driving case on hearing an Aughnacloy narrowly avoided colliding with a group of schoolchildren.

item.title: Attempted child sexual communication case to move to crown court
item.description: Charges against a Ballygawley man accused of attempted child sexual communication are to move to crown court.

item.title: Showroom transformed into Santa’s grotto for children in need
item.description: Monaghan Brothers in Lisnaskea transformed their Isuzu showroom into a Santa’s grotto for a Christmas toy appeal.

item.title: Erneside Shopping Centre sold for £12.4 million
item.description: Savills is pleased to announce the sale of Erneside Shopping Centre, the dominant retail destination in Enniskillen, for £12.4m.

item.title: Police seize counterfeit goods worth hundreds of thousands of pounds
item.description: Police have seized counterfeit goods potentially worth hundreds of thousands of pounds during an operation in the town yesterday (Monday).

item.title: Police catch drink driver near primary school 'at pick-up time'
item.description: A man has been arrested for drink driving close to a primary school at pupil pick-up time following police enforcement activity across Fermanagh and Omagh.
